Name: Rebalance Weapons
Author: Azzu
Description:
[size=4][b]Description[/b][/size]
The main intention is to tune down weapons of several mods (mostly [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/7286]Ridgeside Village[/url]) to not be stronger than the Infinity weapons in raw power. In addition, it is designed with the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/29830]Wildcat combat overhaul[/url] and its changes to the vanilla Defense stat in mind, and while it is not a strict requirement, it is strongly suggested to use it in addition to this mod.

The only strict requirement is [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3753]Stardew Valley Expanded[/url], because it modifies the power of the Infinity weapon, and every other balance adjustment of this mod is based on these values, not the Vanilla ones.

In addition to the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/29830]Wildcat combat overhaul[/url], I would also suggest [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/24355]Walk of Life - Profession Overhaul[/url], as it makes combat even more fun.

[size=4][b]Rebalanced Mods[/b][/size]

General changes everywhere: Defense reduced to fit Wildcat tweaks & Precision reduced from 0-100 to 0-10 scale (many mods did this wrong)

[b]Stardew Valley Expanded[/b]
[spoiler]
[list]
[*]Infinity Blade: Crit chance reduced to 5% from 20%[/*]
[*]Monster Splitter: Knockback increased, AoE increased, speed reduced[/*]
[*]Heavy Shield: Defense increased from 35 to 50[/*]
[/list][/spoiler]

[b]Ridgeside Village[/b]
[spoiler]
Too many changes to list them all, but each weapon has been touched to make it unique in some way. I will list here only the changes that are not apparent from the stats:
[list]
[*]Battle Dancer's Fan: Super fast & high crit (50%) but low crit damage multiplier (x1.2)[/*]
[*]Bronze Lance: High knockback and very slow for a dagger[/*]
[*]Bubble Club: Super high crit (80%) but low crit damage multiplier (x1.5)[/*]
[*]Cute but Deadly Knife: Very low knockback and very fast, so you can keep moving while fighting and enemies stay in weapon range[/*]
[*]Daggerkin: Long range/AoE for a dagger[/*]
[*]Dusked Kunai: No knockback but high stats[/*]
[*]Father's Sorrow: Very low knockback, very slow, but high damage[/*]
[*]Free Lance: Very high knockback for a dagger[/*]
[*]Heartbreaker: So much knockback that it practically teleports enemies away from you[/*]
[*]Pale Wings: Short range/AoE[/*]
[*]Lovesick: 69[/*]
[*]River Harpoon: Very long range/AoE[/*]
[*]The Green Gambler: Very low knockback; no crit damage multiplier (x1.0)[/*]
[*]The Prankster: 67[/*]
[*]The Wild Whip: No crit damage multiplier (x1.0)[/*]
[*]Tide Bringer: Extremely long range/AoE[/*]
[*]Treble Cleaver: Low crit damage multiplier (x1.5)[/*]
[/list][/spoiler]

[b]Lunna - Astray[/b]
[spoiler]
Simply all numbers reduced[/spoiler]

[b]Sunberry Village[/b]
[spoiler]
[list]
[*]Baleful Blade: Defense reduced to 2 from 10[/*]
[*]Sunslash: Damage reduced to 90-130 from 110-160[/*]
[/list][/spoiler]

[b]Adventurer's Guild Expanded[/b]
[spoiler]
Only the general precision changes.[/spoiler]


[size=4][b]Contact[/b][/size]
I am mostly not monitoring the posts or bugs on Nexus mods, please create a [url=https://gitlab.com/azzurite-mods/stardew-rebalance-weapons/-/work_items]work item on Gitlab[/url] if you want a timely response from me. If you want another mod added to this, just ask.

[size=4][b]No LLM used in the creation of this mod.[/b][/size]
